components.gap: The handbook states its own route's conditions (iid sampling, fixed class, pointwise countable core), but it does not state the source's measurability and independent-sampling conditions. The required SIAM English presentation is not held, so their preservation cannot be checked. Classes without a pointwise countable core also receive no ordinary-probability or outer-probability treatment (vc body 51-57), so no bound is calculated with an explicit uniform domain for such classes.
